rounds.title: Grid baseline
rounds.note: The SDK grid (et-grid, et-grid-item, et-grid-item-toolbar, et-grid-item-default-actions), first drawing, drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design/grid with the real markup and CSS: grid, grid item, item toolbar and default actions sheets, the et-resize-handles sheet (via @ethlete/core/design/resize-handles) and the xs transparent et-icon-button for remove. Items are laid out by a copy of the lib's grid maths. Framed as a 480px page with 16px padding; 448px content, 4 columns (a consumer breakpoint, the default at this width would be 2), rowHeight 100 and gap 16 (the defaults), so a 1x1 cell is 100 x 100. Items take the next surface elevation, as the lib does. The item content (title and muted subtitle) is consumer content, drawn by the mock. States: rest (four 2x1 items), spans (2x1, 2x2, 1x1, 1x1, 4x1), item-hover (the 2x2 item: the eight resize bars and pips), item-focus-visible (same item), actions (a registered actionsComponent: the remove button in every item), action-hover and action-focus-visible (remove on the first item), dragging (the Orders tile lifted 70 / 18 px off its slot, Refunds moved into its slot, the drop placeholder at the target slot), resizing (Activity grown to 4x2 by its south edge: every handle shown), long-title (a long first title with actions). Static snapshot: the move, enter and settle transitions drawn at rest. The lib has no empty state (an empty grid is 0px high) and no loading state, so neither is drawn. Numbers (light / dark), from shot pixels at scale 2, brand mint, a: item fill vs page 1.14 / 1.18; item focus ring (2px inset outline, primary) vs the item fill 1.16 / 11.40 (vs page 1.33 / 13.50); remove button focus ring (et-focus-ring, primary) vs fill 1.16 / 11.40; remove icon at rest (muted) vs fill 6.86 / 5.86, on hover (surface colour) vs its tint 15.31 / 12.07; remove hover tint vs fill 1.03 / 1.20; resize bars and pips (surface colour at 20 % opacity) vs fill 1.51 / 1.88; drop placeholder: dashed edge vs page 1.80 / 2.29, fill vs page 1.17 / 1.23. Q98 numbers only: the item has no edge, so its fill alone sets it off the page (1.14 / 1.18); the placeholder edge 1.80 / 2.29. Decided rules that arise: Q88 (the item focus ring and the remove button focus ring). Q99a does not arise: the only mint marks are the two focus rings, which Q88 covers; the remove hover tint is an interaction tint, kept. No mint fill, so no ink edge, so Q102 does not arise; c is a look variant, not a Q102 one. Q101 does not arise: no filled button. The long title now ends before the actions (lib fix 4bb919726: an item with actions pads its content end by --et-grid-item-actions-reserve, default 2.4rem + 12px). Findings for later, not render refusals: the active resize edge has no style of its own (data-active-edge is set, nothing reads it), so a resize looks like a hover (drawn in c); the dragged item has no lift (no shadow or scale) and reads flat over its neighbours (drawn in c); the resize bars sit at 1.51 vs the fill on light. Later rounds, left out here: read-only, touch handle sizes, keyboard move and resize feedback, the enter and leave fade, the grid padding, per-item radius and background tokens, a custom actions component.

a.note: Today, the lib as is. On light both focus rings are the mint primary: the item ring 1.16 vs the item fill (1.33 vs page), the remove button ring 1.16. Dark 11.40 vs fill. Everything else is surface colour: remove icon 6.86 / 5.86, resize bars 1.51 / 1.88, placeholder edge 1.80 / 2.29.

b.note: Pick. a plus Q88: the item focus ring (outline-color) and the remove button focus ring (--_et-focus-ring-color inside et-grid-item-toolbar) take the theme ink. Light: item ring 4.81 vs the fill (was 1.16), 5.48 vs page; remove ring 4.81 (was 1.16). Dark unchanged: the brand ink is the mint, 11.40 vs fill. Nothing else changes; Q99a, Q101 and Q102 do not arise. Picked because it is the only decided rule that applies, it lifts both light rings past 3:1 against the item fill, and it matches the button, banner and breadcrumb picks.

c.note: b plus two looks for the open findings: the resize handle on the edge named by data-active-edge on et-resize-handles goes to 0.6 opacity (the others stay at 0.2), and .et-grid-item--dragging takes a 0 2px 8px shadow, the geometry of the scheduler drag shadow (no runtime elevation token exists; the sketch check refuses rgb(var(--et-shadow-color-rgb) / 0.25), so the colour is the surface colour at 25 % on light and the background at 60 % on dark via light-dark; the lib would use --et-shadow-color-rgb). Light: active south bar 4.47 vs the fill (was 1.51, the other bars stay 1.51); the shadow darkens the neighbour fill under the dragged item from 240 to 213 (1.29) and the placeholder beside it from 237 to 220 (1.20), a and b show no change (1.00). A new look; needs a lib change if Tom picks it.
